coaching.headline: The duo ran riot. We turned it into a strong win.
coaching.team: Drongo and Phase had a hell of a game: lethal carry, deathless support, and a win without dragging it into a coin flip. The early Fangtooth went against us, but we took the next two and finished ahead on towers. Trading Fangtooth for their Mini Prime kept our objective progress moving. Keep that confidence and make the next take-or-reset call together.

focus.title: Make the next call obvious
focus.evidence: Five favorable kill clusters are recorded; three had a major objective or structure follow within 90 seconds. The other two do not establish that an objective was safely available. Health, wave position and travel time are not captured.
focus.action: After the next won fight, name one reachable objective or tower, check the wave and surviving threats, then call take or reset. Everyone should hear the decision before splitting up.

perPlayer.dba6b55f-c3aa-499a-aa76-266f3f9610d5: Drongo was the fucking problem they never solved. Huge damage, repeated kills on their duo, barely any time dead. Keep that balance. When Greystone comes into range, hit him from beside the team instead of spending the escape to reach Kira; once the threat is gone and a wave arrives, put those expensive bullets into the tower. This game earned confidence, not a license to dive everything.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase stayed alive and contributed to nearly every kill. Deathless with that much involvement is a damn good support game. Keep enabling the damage dealer. When Drongo commits to a target he can actually hit, match Hyperflux to that shooting window; if he needs pulling out, call it before yanking him away from the kill. Make the partnership deliberate.
perPlayer.8d51b81b-7acf-4747-8b3a-2a225758fb5e: Khaimera brought the team's biggest objective damage contribution. Keep giving the squad something to collect beyond kills. Before starting the next major objective, call whether the plan is to finish it or turn on Greystone if he approaches, and get Drongo's answer. Half the team burning the monster while the other half starts a different fight is how a comfortable game becomes bullshit.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Belica's farm was strong, but Argus got both her deaths, including one just before their first Fangtooth. That is the sequence worth tightening. When the next objective is coming up, clear from safety and keep Seismic Assault available if Argus can threaten the route. Call a delayed rotation instead of forcing a trade to leave lane. Keep the income; arrive ready to use it.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel does not need to cosplay Drongo on the damage chart. He led our mitigation and kept his deaths down. With this carry ahead, the next grouped push needs a bodyguard: when Greystone or Scarlett steps toward Drongo, use the stun to stop that threat before chasing their backline. Let the wave take tower shots. Keep the durability, and make it buy the carry room to work.

13.9.call: We won the kill sequence and then took Fangtooth while they took Mini Prime. Keep the trade in perspective. The next call is whether the nearby lane and remaining health allow a tower, not an automatic sprint to the other pit.

19.7.call: A clean kill sequence was followed by towers and another Fangtooth. That is the sequence to repeat: agree on the reachable prize and finish it before looking for another fight.

21.9.call: Drongo and Khaimera died in the final favorable exchange, then another enemy tower fell. When the main carry is down, check the wave and surviving defenders before extending; the earlier lead does not make every push free.

dba6b55f-c3aa-499a-aa76-266f3f9610d5.matchup: Drongo and Phase faced Kira and Ikra. Their completed items offered damage and sustain rather than physical armor, while Greystone's healing made him the more persistent front-line problem. The build question is how to keep damaging the target Drongo can reach safely, not how to chase their already-struggling carry.
dba6b55f-c3aa-499a-aa76-266f3f9610d5.build: Lightning Hawk adds an energized slowing attack; Imperator rewards the build's critical chance, and Vanquisher adds a low-health finish. Demolisher still penetrates base armor, but its extra bonus-armor penetration had little obvious item armor to work against here. That makes the last slot debatable, not wasted. Final inventory does not establish when these effects became available or how much damage each supplied.
dba6b55f-c3aa-499a-aa76-266f3f9610d5.eternal: Weald rewards damaging low-health heroes, matching the finishing role. Forage adds farm income and experience; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after a mobility trigger. Pacifier gives this loadout a dash, but the record does not show whether that combination was used. In a draft where sustained trading matters more than post-dash attacks, Taproot trades Wind-Rider's short attack-speed boost for on-hit healing. Phase's sustain supports keeping the aggressive option here.
dba6b55f-c3aa-499a-aa76-266f3f9610d5.augment: Bring The Boom adds Rad Rounds splash around the target. It is useful when Greystone or Scarlett is the reachable target and other enemies stand nearby, without requiring Drongo to dive onto them. The match does not measure splash hits, so keep it for that fight plan rather than crediting it for the kill total.
dba6b55f-c3aa-499a-aa76-266f3f9610d5.crest: Pacifier supplies a dash and an empowered follow-up hit, with a possible recast after a quick kill. That gives Drongo both finishing pressure and a way to reposition against Greystone. The cost of using it forward is losing that immediate escape option; kill totals do not establish that its resets or damage were decisive.
dba6b55f-c3aa-499a-aa76-266f3f9610d5.improvement: Tainted Rounds is worth comparing with Demolisher when Greystone's healing is the obstacle on Drongo's own target. Phase owning Tainted Scepter and Steel owning Tainted Guard does not guarantee either is applying it to that target at the right time. The swap gains direct healing reduction and gives up Demolisher's armor penetration. Keep Demolisher if armor becomes the bigger problem; this win does not prove a compulsory swap.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Phase supported Drongo into Kira and Ikra, with Greystone and Scarlett as additional threats when fights grouped. Ikra's Combustion adds burst, while Astral Catalyst gains damage against shields. Phase's native sustain is healing, but that does not make Astral Catalyst irrelevant to shielded teammates such as Steel or Belica using Soulbearer.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Prophecy spends a slot on Phase's own attacks, and Fervour gives those attacks a support payoff by healing nearby allies. Tainted Scepter offers healing reduction through magical damage against Greystone and Kira's sustain; Galaxy Greaves adds both armors. This is a workable damage-and-sustain package, but its attack-based value depends on safe opportunities to attack. The deathless result does not tell us how often those opportunities occurred.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Exarch turns healing into attack speed and magical on-hit damage for the recipient, fitting a linked Drongo. Preservation improves healing and shielding received by Phase; Fervour rewards attacks on enemy heroes with nearby healing. Revelation is a draft alternative to Preservation for more frequent basic abilities, but that trades personal sustain away. Zero deaths does not prove Preservation was unnecessary or that another minor would have performed better.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Psychic Support restores the linked ally's missing mana through Essence Catalyst. That fits keeping Drongo supplied across repeated ability use; the record does not show mana shortages or the amount restored. Keep it for longer exchanges. A different augment needs an identified problem it solves, not merely a more popular selection.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Tranquility gives nearby healing and brief damage mitigation, a useful response when Greystone or Scarlett reaches the group. It also increases the ward cap. Neither the cap nor the total wards placed tells us whether the right approach was covered, and the match does not establish active timing.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: If Phase cannot safely attack often, Marshal in Prophecy's slot shifts value from her personal on-hit damage toward nearby allies' attack speed. If immobilization is denying Drongo his shooting time, Enra's Blessing offers a conditional shield for affected allies instead. Those are different problems with different answers. Keep Tainted Scepter when Phase can reliably apply its healing reduction to the enemy the team is focusing.

8d51b81b-7acf-4747-8b3a-2a225758fb5e.matchup: Greystone was the opposing jungler and a substantial healer; Scarlett's Mutilator also pressures a health-stacking Khaimera. The gank targets included an Argus and Ikra with damage-focused inventories. That makes reaching a target with follow-up useful, but surviving the enemy bruisers matters once Khaimera has committed.
8d51b81b-7acf-4747-8b3a-2a225758fb5e.build: Overlord adds health-scaled attacks and cleave, plus permanent health from unit kills. Basilisk reduces the armor of heroes Khaimera damages, which can also help Drongo against that same target. Draconum increases healing through repeated damage and restores health on takedowns. This package favors sustained contact. Lack of completed enemy armor items does not make Basilisk useless: heroes still have base armor, and temporary bonuses are not captured by an inventory list.
8d51b81b-7acf-4747-8b3a-2a225758fb5e.eternal: Lotus provides random growing bonuses; Early Bloom supplies an extra level at its threshold. Immaculate reduces damage only while health is high, so it is protection for that state rather than a blanket bonus throughout a brawl. Healing may return Khaimera to that state, but uptime is unknown. Prima Donna is an aggressive draft alternative that also increases damage received; this game gives no reason to treat that risk as a free upgrade.
8d51b81b-7acf-4747-8b3a-2a225758fb5e.augment: Feral Ambush extends the leap's range, which helps reach a called gank target. Its value is access, not permission to engage beyond the team's ability to follow. Keep it for that purpose. The kill locations do not prove an invasion-focused augment would have been better.
8d51b81b-7acf-4747-8b3a-2a225758fb5e.crest: Iceskorn Talons creates a zone that helps allied physical damage and movement while slowing enemies on it. That can serve both Khaimera and Drongo when they fight within its area. It is a positional benefit, not a permanent team buff; the record has no active-use or occupancy evidence.
8d51b81b-7acf-4747-8b3a-2a225758fb5e.improvement: Keep the sustained-fight package if Khaimera can stay on the same target with Drongo. Sky Splitter is a conditional alternative to Basilisk for more attack speed, lifesteal and current-health damage, sacrificing health, haste and shared armor reduction. For Greystone, check who can actually apply anti-heal during the duel; teammates owning it elsewhere on the map is not coverage.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Belica faced Argus, who finished Azure Core, Combustion and Wraith Leggings. Azure Core's mana and defensive shield complicate the burst calculation: Belica's ultimate rewards missing mana, not merely a large maximum pool. Across the team, Greystone and Scarlett offer larger health pools for her damage, while Argus accounted for both recorded deaths. That identifies a matchup to examine, not proof of how either death happened.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion supplies an ability-triggered burst, while Noxia needs damage from a separate ability after the mark. Seismic Assault into Void Bomb is a clear way to pursue that condition; repeated hits from one ability are not a substitute. Noxia's maximum-health damage also has a purpose against their bruisers. Only two completed items are listed, so a missing third item is not itself a build mistake.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Aion provides mana regeneration from casting and income from spell damage to heroes. Bottomless Vial adds power and a potion charge for personally killing River Buffs; team river control cannot verify Belica's stacks. Runic Focus rewards a high current mana percentage, not simply buying a larger mana pool. Keep Bottomless Vial when the lane plan includes securing those buffs; Philosopher is the draft alternative for steadier income without that requirement.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience. It fits a farming and rotation plan, but the strong farm total cannot be attributed to the augment alone. Keep it if that is the intended plan; choosing a damage augment next draft would exchange those benefits for a different combat payoff, not retroactively fix the Argus deaths.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Soulbearer's temporary shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed give Belica a defensive tool against Argus and incoming bruisers. Its shield scales with power and mana. Ikra's Astral Catalyst can increase damage against that shield, so it is protection with a counterinteraction rather than guaranteed safety. Actual use is not recorded.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: If Belica survives the first exchange but lacks finishing damage, Wraith Leggings adds penetration and pressure against low-health targets. If Argus burst prevents her from completing the exchange, weigh a defensive purchase before more offense. The deciding evidence is whether survival or damage is limiting the next fight, not a requirement to finish the common core.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.matchup: Steel faced Scarlett's Mutilator, Infernum and The Perforator, a package that pressures health and armor. Greystone adds sustained physical pressure, while Argus and Ikra mean the full match is not exclusively a physical-defense problem. Scarlett earned both kills on Steel, but the record does not isolate the cause or show which item passives were active.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Fire Blossom rewards remaining close with its burn. Tainted Guard applies a bleed and healing reduction when an enemy basic attacks Steel, making it relevant against Greystone only when that trigger occurs. Both items provide physical armor for the bruiser matchup. Scarlett's Infernum gains damage from bonus armor, but that interaction does not mean armor stops protecting Steel against her other physical damage.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Krix increases maximum health; Regenerative Tissue restores health after a break from hero damage, while Cannibalism adds permanent health on takedowns. This supports recovering between lane trades and growing sturdier. Festering Wounds is a draft alternative to Regenerative Tissue when applying anti-heal through immobilization is more useful than recovery between trades. Unlike Tainted Guard, that route does not require the enemy to attack Steel first.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.augment: Heavy Metal turns total physical and magical armor into additional magical damage on heavy punches and Shield Bash. That supports a defensive build which still threatens nearby enemies. Keep it; neither the low objective-damage total nor this win establishes that an offensive replacement is needed.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.crest: Razorback temporarily raises both armors and reflects a portion of pre-mitigation hero damage. It fits receiving committed damage from Scarlett or Greystone, but cannot force them to attack Steel instead of Drongo. The useful timing is when their damage is actually coming into Steel; the record cannot verify that timing.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.improvement: Flux Matrix is a next-slot option if Argus and Ikra become the limiting threats: magical armor and nearby magic-damage amplification can help Steel and Belica together. It gives up the physical-defense emphasis of another physical-armor purchase. Keep Tainted Guard when its attacker-triggered anti-heal is useful. Do not remove all armor merely because Scarlett has Infernum.

synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.
